title: EditFile
description: Edit a file by replacing old_str with new_str. The old_str must be unique in the file (use enough context to disambiguate). Produces a unified diff for user review before applying. A git checkpoint is created after the edit is applied.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

old_str.description: The exact text to replace. Must be unique in the file. Include enough surrounding context (3-5 lines) to disambiguate. Use empty new_str to delete.

new_str.description: The text to replace old_str with. Use empty string to delete old_str.

replace_all.description: If true, replace all occurrences of old_str in the file. Use with caution — usually you want the default (unique match).
